title: Core Septet #14
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted.
